description: This file defines an abstract Android Service named ThreadService that manages background threading and messaging mechanisms. It includes input and output handlers, message constants for controlling thread states (start, stop, suspend, resume), and communication protocols with clients via Messenger. The class is intended to be extended with custom worker thread logic by implementing the abstract method workerThreadRun().

classes.name: ThreadService
classes.description: An abstract Android Service class that manages a background worker thread with inter-process communication via Messengers. It handles thread lifecycle control messages and provides a framework for extending with custom worker thread logic.

classes.name: InputHandler
classes.description: Handler subclass that processes incoming messages from clients to control threading operations.

classes.name: OutputInterface
classes.description: Interface defining a method for handling outgoing messages to clients.

classes.name: OutputHandler
classes.description: Handler subclass that forwards messages to an OutputInterface implementation.

classes.name: WorkerThreadRunnable
classes.description: Runnable implementation running the worker thread logic, calling the abstract workerThreadRun() method.

methods.name: handleInputMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming control messages to manage the worker thread, including start, stop, suspend, and resume commands.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends messages to connected clients via the Messenger.

methods.name: workerThreadRun
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to implement specific background thread behavior.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes thread control variables when the service is created.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder for client communication.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up thread resources when the service is destroyed.
